identity.name: E1_Logistics_Pro
identity.core_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. Data is the art. Dark mode is the canvas.

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-weight 800. Use for KPI values and Section Headers.
usage_rules.body: High legibility, tracking-normal. Use for labels and descriptions.
usage_rules.mono: Use for ALL numerical data (prices, liters, coordinates) to ensure alignment.

map.marker_style: Custom SVG icons. Green for cheap fuel, Red for expensive. Pulsing effect for 'Recommended'.

cards.style: Glassmorphism with 1px border. border-white/10 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 sharp-edges or minimal radius (rounded-sm). uppercase text.

visual_enhancers.gradients: No full screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for 'glow' effects on active elements.

images.description: Side view of a modern truck at night, use for vehicle details section background or hero.
Lit up gas station at night, use for the 'Best Price' recommendation card.
Black and white gas station, use for list items.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React. Preferred icons: Fuel, MapPin, Truck, Navigation, Calculator, Settings, AlertTriangle.

implementation_steps.action: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables for the 'dark' theme. Ensure 'light' theme variables are also compatible or force dark mode.
Create a main layout with a full-screen div for the map and a fixed/absolute positioned sidebar (right side) for the controls. Use z-index to layer them.
Initialize Leaflet map. Add TileLayer (Dark Matter). Create a custom 'StationMarker' component that accepts price and status.
Create the sidebar using the 'Glassmorphism' style. Divide into sections: 'Vehicle Status', 'Route Calculator', 'Station List'.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use the 70/30 split.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for the sidebar.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays without a blur/scrim.
